name: Glycemic Status Assessment for Patients With Diabetes: poor control (>9.0%)
certification: Approximation of HEDIS Glycemic Status Assessment for Patients With Diabetes (GSD >9.0%), not certified: built from NCQA's public measure summary; the licensed HEDIS value sets are not used (codes here are public ICD-10-CM/LOINC/CPT examples).
steward: NCQA (HEDIS GSD); CMS eCQM CMS122 / MSSP APP Quality ID 001
spec_year: CMS122v14 (2026 performance period); HEDIS GSD MY2025 (2027 Star Ratings C12)

citations.title: eCQI Resource Center: CMS122v14 Diabetes: Glycemic Status Assessment Greater Than 9% (2026 performance period)
NCQA public measure page: Glycemic Status Assessment for Patients With Diabetes (GSD)
2027 Part C & D Star Ratings Technical Notes (last updated 09/30/2026; measurement year 2025 data)
Medicare Shared Savings Program Quality Performance Standard: PY2026 40th Percentile MIPS Quality Performance Category Score (Dec 2025), Table 1 APP Plus Quality Measure Set

denominator.summary: Members 18-75 at period end with diabetes (ICD-10 E10/E11/E13 or Agere diabetes concepts) in the measurement or prior year; enrolled.

criteria.label: Diabetes diagnosis (E10, E11, E13) in the measurement or prior year

exclusions.label: Hospice or palliative care (Z51.5 / hospice encounter)

numerator.summary: Most recent HbA1c in the period > 9.0% (lowest value on the most recent date), or no HbA1c in the period (missing counts as poor control).

gap_label: Diabetes: HbA1c > 9% or not tested this period
notes: GMI (glucose management indicator) also counts in HEDIS GSD; CGM data is not received.
HEDIS identifies diabetes from claims/encounters (two outpatient diagnoses or one acute visit) or pharmacy; Agere uses any coded diagnosis.
